note: Planted defects. A finding hits a defect when its quote contains the anchor text or any "also" anchor (a defect can be described on more than one line), or its line number is one of those anchors' lines. clean-*.ps1 files have no planted defects: every finding there is a candidate false alarm, to be read by a person.

defects.what: turns off TLS certificate checks on the upload
password passed on the command line, visible in the process list
an empty BuildDir expands to \* and deletes from the drive root
downloads and runs remote code with no verification
caller-supplied Name is inserted into a command string run by Invoke-Expression
values containing = are cut short, and a line with no = throws a null error
no timeout: loops forever if the service never starts
empty catch hides every error, including a wrong URL
writes the API token to the log file in plain text
unvalidated Name such as ..\..\x writes outside the log folder
